title: Availability data synchronizes immediately upon update
gherkin:
Given a system with availability data
When availability status is updated
Then the updated availability is synchronized immediately across all components
And no delay is introduced in the synchronization process
rationale: Verifies that availability updates propagate immediately without any latency, which is the core requirement of immediate synchronization.
generationSummary: Immediate availability synchronization ensures that availability data is synchronized in real-time across the system without delay. This requirement focuses on maintaining up-to-date availability information across all relevant components and systems.
